calculation.description: Ranks an instrument inversely by its position within its recent 10-session high-low channel. Assets near channel lows receive higher reversal scores; constant channels are invalid. The signal uses only completed historical closes.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.05357, ICIR 0.15780), weakened during 2023-2024 (0.02382, ICIR 0.06544), and recovered in 2025-2026 (0.05067, ICIR 0.15540). The all-period estimate uses the available 15-instrument universe and at least 8 valid instruments per date; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section is small.
